facts.fact: The Ministry of Health says five health facilities in Mamou and Dalaba districts were digitalised with OpenClinic software, which offers interoperability with the national system (DHIS2), and that paper reporting into the SNIS continues alongside it.

slug: 2025-11-27 Interoperability - key workshop to modernize Guinea's health information system

facts.fact: A November 2025 workshop in Conakry, part of the drive to strengthen the SNIS, was told that aggregated data from the REC maternité register piloted in 15 health centres would feed the SNIS, and a ministry official framed the aim as centralising national health information in one system.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's PASA2 page says SNIS data is entered on the DHIS2 platform, with 77 solar systems installed in 7 regions and 33 health districts to power data entry and 21 facilities given internet and computers.
